run_rmsnorm: run the rmsnorm function to compute root mean square normalization on a 2D PyTorch tensor
run_rmsnorm_kernel: run the Triton JIT rmsnorm_kernel to normalize tensor data on GPU with configurable block size
test_rmsnorm: test the rmsnorm function with a 2D contiguous tensor and weight vector to verify normalization output
review_rmsnorm_kernel: review the rmsnorm_kernel Triton JIT function for eviction policy and block-based RMS normalization logic
refactor_rmsnorm: refactor the rmsnorm function to support non-contiguous input tensors or additional normalization options
